libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.forgetBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from this list. No file or folder is deleted, and you can add the folder again later.

library.title: Library settings: {{name}}
library.excludedHint: These folders are not scanned or indexed.
library.mcpHint: Lets Claude Code query this library. It listens only on this computer and needs a token.
library.mcpWriteHint: Off by default: the server is read-only.

secrets.title: API keys
secrets.intro: Keys for the library "{{name}}". They are stored encrypted in the system's secure storage. Once saved they cannot be viewed again, only replaced or deleted.
secrets.storage: Keys are never written to the library folder or to any synchronised file.
secrets.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace it

network.title: Online sources
network.intro: Citations and monitoring use OpenAlex, arXiv and Semantic Scholar, and only when you ask. Only identifiers and titles leave this computer, never the text of your documents.
network.openAlexEmail: Send my profile email to OpenAlex
network.openAlexEmailHint: OpenAlex answers faster and more reliably when it knows an email to contact. Off by default: the email leaves this computer only if you turn this on.
network.noEmail: Add an email to your profile above to turn this on.

apiKey.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
apiKey.hint: A free key from your OpenAlex account settings gives you your own daily budget, and is needed to read more than the 200 most recent "cited by" works of a document. It is kept in the system's secure storage and is never shown again.
apiKey.label: OpenAlex API key
apiKey.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace the saved one
